[RARC.12.1] Synthetic names ([LLEX.10.6.1]), `$` followed by the name, e.g.
`$ClockTick`, are the DS compiler's and the engine's own. No source text can
write one, so no author schema, rule or binding collides with one. The compiler
uses them for machine-generated names created during desugaring and for
engine-internal facts the runtime asserts directly:
